title: Pay Back Your Ego and Learn
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Dastoor Ya Sayyidee, madad!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
La ilaha illa-Llah, la ilaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha-Llah Muhammad Rasulullah, `alayhi salaatullah `alayhi
salaamullah
La ilaha illa-Llah, la ilaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Muhammad habeebullah `alayhi salaatullah `alayhi
salaamullah
O our Lord, forgive us, and bless your weak servants and we are saying thousands and thousands praisings
and glory on your most honored servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s.) For his honor, forgive us, O our Lord.
Stand up, O people! Give your highest respect and glorifying and praising for the Lord of Heavens, for the
Lord of whole creations from pre-Eternal up to Eternal.

(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Dastoor Ya RijaalAllah, madad. O Awliya, O holy ones, that you have an honor in heavenly presence of the
Seal of Prophets. And we are asking from our master, that he is qutb of this planet; and the master's onelooking towards heavenly presence, another-looking for their missions, or for their importance. When that
qutb looking for this planet, his looking for everything on it never making him to be occupied with anything
(in order) to be in the heavenly presence of the Lord of Heavens.
•• ••••• ••• •••• •• ••• - "La yashghilhu shaani shaanun an shaan - one affair does not keep Him busy from
attending another"; they are in perfection through their creation. Their spirituality or spiritual being can't
leave it's position in the heavenly presence of the Lord of Heavens. And at the same time, they are using
another position, that for arranging everything on this planet. Everything must be under their control! That is
their honor. Their hearts never going to leave heavenly presence of the Lord of Heavens.
Therefore, the Lord of Heavens is saying: "qalbu 'l-mu'min ` arshullah - the Heart of the believer is the
Throne of God." Their heavenly being, qalb, is not a piece of flesh. This is only to make our bodies to work as
is necessary, to control everything. Therefore when heart is going to be a little bit upset, whole body getting to
be upset. Therefore this piece of flesh, that is controlling everything for Mankind through their physical
being, is under his control. Sending. Without someone sending, do you think that our blood can move or can
know where it is going or what is it's importance? Some of our blood is running up to our heads and that is
different from that coming to our eyes. And that power that our heart is using or sending; everything is in its
real position. Everything just planned and can't be in a wrong way; must be 100 % in perfection. Who is
sitting through your heart and controlling you? One holy one! The Lord of Heavens giving that authority to
that one who is controlling Mankind on this planet. And at the same time, there are other holy ones under
command of qutb, pole. There are others belonging to that one, to look for (after) every creation on earth.
Can't be any wrong action, any wrong movement, any wrong being on it. Everything must be in its perfect
position. When losing that perfection, man may fall sick, or no more control on his physical being and
passing away. That power just taken up from that person; that person finishing here and going.
Therefore Allah Almighty is Subhaan. Allah, All Mighty. Everything is in highest position and highest
perfection through every creation. Everything must be under a power station. Look, one atom. Do you think

that atom is moving by itself? And its creation is by itself ? Or a grant to it from outside. Or, they are
preparing by themselves to be hydrogen atom, or oxygen atom, or iron atom? They are saying that there are
104 or 105 kinds of atoms. Do you think that they can't be more, or can't be less? Or in opposite. May be, an
atom in an opposite direction. Two directions, up or down. By itself? And our scientists or chemists or
physicist's are only knowing the Mendeleev system. The Lord of Heavens under a control? Mendeleev was
saying that there should be 99 elements. Really 99, but they are trying to make it more. They can't do. No
permission for them. Therefore they are trying to make one more and that is going to be an artificial atom. An
artificial atom is an imitated being in existence. You can't do this. Therefore, they are taking the reasons of
being an element; sometimes, if that power is taken from it, just disappearing. And Allah Almighty's power,
qudrah; His Might, can't be in limits. That is what is musakhkhar, just granted to man to run in it; as a circle.
"You may be in this," enjoy yourself. Allah may do whole world through one atom's circle and may say to all
people: you do as you like here. This bigness that we are looking and seeing can be in limits through an
atomic being. He is Allah!
O our listeners, use your minds. Think on it. To think for something through creation, Prophet (s) saying, ••••
•••• ••• •• ••••• ••••• ••• - "tafakkaru sa`atin khayrun min ` ibaadati saba`eena sanah - to think for deepless
limits of creation, even one hour is good for you than to make 70 years praying." Because you can pray
heedlessly for 70 years and never understand anything the Lord of Heavens is saying. SubhaanAllah! Glory
for Allah! O our Salafi `ulama, what do you think when Allah Almighty saying: ast`aidhubillah, ••••• ••••••••
•••••••• •••••••••• •••••• ••••••••••••• - "wa maa khalaqtu 'l-jinna wa 'l-insa illa li y`abudoon - I created Jinn
and Mankind only to worship Me," (51:56.) Giving meanings of illa li y`abudoon, li y`arifoon, nihaayatu `
indahu li ya`rafoonee! I granted them such a power that with it they may reach through My Own Being's
knowledges, m`arifah. Being, m`arifatullah: wa maa khalaqtu 'l-jinna wa 'l-insa illa li y`abudoon. That is one
of the most important power oceans for creation, for Mankind; specially for Mankind: wa maa khalaqtu 'ljinn wa 'l-ins. Why jinn is first and man second? I am asking them! To say something to me, but they can't
say.
Therefore, we are using holy words of Allah Almighty, what He is saying. If you are not knowing, ••••••••• ••••
•••••••• - "f 'as'al bihi khabeera - ask thou then about Him of any acquainted (with such things)." (25:59.)
Nothing can be unknown in the level of servanthood. Closed for servants. You only know a servanthood level

that is necessary for yourself, t`azheeman; by glorifying the Lord. All knowledge that was granted through
holy books to prophets and from prophets to common people, for what? To differentiate, li y`arifoon. That
level for whole creation; level "`uqool," which means, those who are granted an understanding through their
minds and mentalities. The summary of whole messengerhood or prophethood is on two points: one, the
level of servants; they are granted a knowledge through heavenly ones; they are prophets. Teaching them
about their existence, about their creation, about their missions. This teaching is one level and they are
learning on it only. They must know this. Up (above this level,) is only for Allah and that, no one knows
about. They are not responsible for that knowledge. We are only learning through prophets. Their prophecy is
teaching people about themselves, about their beings, about their missions, about their purpose; for what
they have been created. That level and not above it.
Li y`arifoon, means, I only created Jinn and Man for understanding their Creator; that there is a Creator who
created us and He is always from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. He is an Unknown One. What we are knowing is
only t`azheem, glorifying. We must know that there is a Sultan, but hawiyya, the identity of Sultan is
impossible for us to know. We only must learn that there is our Lord and we must give our endless glorifying
to Him. How can we do that? That is level of teaching: f 'as'al bihi khabeera. Common people are on that
level. They are knowing nothing, therefore, the Lord of Heavens is sending us special or selected ones.
Dressing such a power, that no one can be able to come close for understanding.
What are Salafi Ulema saying? What do you think the holy words that Allah Almighty is saying, mean.
••••••••••• •••••• ••••••••••••••• •••••• - W 'attaqullaha wa yu`allimukumullah - so fear God, for it is God That
teaches you." (2:282) What does it mean? You are thinking that knowledge is only through the writing of any
book? No, that book is not teaching you, but the teacher; specialised, chosen people, because they are keeping
as they can carry, to make their last glorifying to Him. Then they should be granted from heavenly ones such
a knowledge that common people can't reach. Therefore, 'ulema,' are learned people, not learning from books
but their teacher. The Lord of Heavens is saying: w 'attaqullaha wa ` allimukumullah. (and) ••••••••••• •••••••
•••••••••• - "Ar-Rahmaan ` allama 'l-quraan - The Most Merciful, taught the Qur'an." (55:1,2) Not Jibreel.
Bringing, but teaching; Who was teacher of Sayyidina Muhammad? (s.) His teacher was his Lord, Almighty
Allah.
O People, try to learn. The worst label for man is to be ignorant. Written on millions of people, angels just

putting a label: "ignorant". And written for those whom asking to learn and they are paying something for
learning, when you are going to school, paying fees. What they are paying? They are paying by giving their
egos back and taking in front of their egos, noor, through their hearts. And the blood from their hearts is
running everywhere with noor. If a person is not hearing in every cell, he can't learn anything from Allah
Almighty's teaching. Every cell and everything in a cell; so many kinds of beings in a cell, they must be ready
for understanding then they may understand something. Allah is teaching those people, not like ourselves
hasharaat, the lowest level creatures. Allah Almighty is not teaching them. Teaching the best ones from
people. Therefore, best ones they are prophets and through whole creation the best of bests, only Sayyidina
Muhammad (s).
Allah is saying, ar-Rahmaan ` allama 'l-quraan. O our Salafi `ulama, where are you, where is your Lord? You
are saying, "we are knowing Qur'an." Who is teaching you? You think that Allah is teaching you? He taught
His most beloved one. Even Sayyidina Jibreel was learning from him because the most close one in Divine
Presence, was Sayyidina Muhamamd (s.) Stand up!
O People, this is a deepless ocean. Such things. The Lord of Heavens is asking to change everything on earth
now, because last days are approaching! The Day of Resurrection is coming and just granted, such pure
people whom they are on steps of the Seal of Prophets. Learning and teaching. Last chance for Mankind! The
Lord of Heavens is asking to clean them. Therefore two labels: on one label is written: "ignorant," second:
"learned one."
Wa min Allahi 't-tawfeeq
Dome, dome, dome, dome 16x
Allah Allah, Allah Allah 4x
Forgive us! Fatiha.
40 minutes. This is an endless ocean, a little bit more and people can't carry. O Man, oceans, oceans, oceans.
Through oceans, new appearances; through oceans, new visions; through oceans, new lightening territories.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar! O People, don't waste your time with this dirty life. Why is it dirty? Because they
are killing each other, that is the biggest sin. For a man to kill another man, biggest sin! Allah Almighty

saying: O bad servant, do you think that I ordered to you to kill someone and they are innocent? My Divine
anger on you. I am sending on you if you killed one, to be killed up to end of the world, every moment.
N'audhubillah, O People don't kill, don't try to make new weapons for killing thousands and millions people.
Allah Almighty should take his revenge for those people because they are oppressors and disobedient
servants and they are the worst servants. May Allah forgive us. Fatiha
45? (yes) He knows, we don't know.
Welcome to you.
Muharram beginning Jumu`ah (Friday, 18 December).
I don’t know; He (swt,) Knows to speak. Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah Sultaan Allah, Ya Rabbee
shukr. Sajdah Allahu akbar
